capabilities: Insert Bible verse text via a --BookChapter:Verse trigger
Insert all verses of a chapter with :a syntax
Fetch verses from other translations with @version keys
Insert a verse of the day with --vod
Insert links only instead of verse text, including offline
extras: Verse fetching uses external Bible APIs, so insertion needs an internet connection; Link Only mode works offline. On iOS, Smart Punctuation conflicts with the -- trigger; the README recommends ++ instead (e.g. ++John1:1) or disabling Smart Punctuation. The repo also links to a related project, Bible Vector Search, and contains a bible-reference-toolkit package for reference normalization.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up and insert Bible verse text or links while writing study notes.
summary: Bible reference plugin that suggests Bible verses as you type reference syntax and inserts the verse text, links, chapters, or a verse of the day.
